blocks.text: Carboxylic acids ke reactions ko in qismon mein banta ja sakta hai:

items: Woh reactions jin mein sirf acidic hydrogen (H⁺ dene wala H) hissa leta hai.
Woh reactions jin mein –OH group kisi aur group se badal jata hai.
Woh reactions jin mein poora carboxyl group (–COOH) hissa leta hai.

blocks.text: A. Acidic hydrogen ke reactions
Carboxylic acids kafi acidic hain kyun ke paani mein H⁺ ions dete hain. Isi liye yeh basic cheezon (bases) aur active (tez react karne wali) metals se react karte hain.
a) Active metals ke saath
b) Alkalis ke saath
c) Metal carbonates aur bicarbonates ke saath (CO₂ ke bulbule nikalte hain)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki NaHCO₃ wali equation mein acid 'CH₂–COOH' chhapa hai; sahi ethanoic acid, CH₃–COOH, hai.
B. –OH group ke badalne wale reactions
Carboxylic acids substitution reactions (aik group ki jagah doosra group aana) kar sakte hain jin mein OH group ki jagah koi aur group, jaise X (halogen), OR ya NH₂, aa jata hai.
a) SOCl₂, PCl₃ aur PCl₅ ke saath (acyl chloride banta hai)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab heading mein PCl₃ ka naam leti hai lekin us ki equation nahi deti. PCl₃ ke saath garam karne par bhi acyl chloride banta hai: 3CH₃COOH + PCl₃ → 3CH₃COCl + H₃PO₃.
b) Alcohols ke saath (esterification)
Carboxylic acids ko concentrated sulphuric acid ki maujoodgi mein alcohols ke saath garam karne se esters bante hain.

blocks.text_alt: CH₃–COOH (ethanoic acid) + C₂H₅OH (ethanol) ⇌ CH₃–COOC₂H₅ (ethyl ethanoate) + H₂O (H₂SO₄)

blocks.text: C. –COOH group ki reduction
Taqatwar reducing agent lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III), LiAlH₄, carboxylic acids ko primary alcohols mein reduce kar deta hai.

blocks.title: Reduction
blocks.text:
i. H₂ (ya H⁻) ka milna
ii. O ya O₂ ka nikalna
iii. X₂ (halogens) ka nikalna
iv. Electrons ka milna
v. Oxidation state ka kam hona
Doosre aam reducing agents, H₂/Ni aur sodium tetrahydridoborate(III) (NaBH₄), carboxylic acids ko reduce nahi karte.
Carboxylic acids ki oxidation
Methanoic acid apni banawat ki wajah se weak aur strong dono oxidizing agents se oxidise ho jata hai, is liye yeh strong reducing agent ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Methanoic acid, H-C(=O)-OH, do baar. Baen wale mein H-C=O hissa dabbe mein, teer 'Aldehydic portion (-CHO) responsible for its behaviour as a powerful reducing agent' ki taraf. Daen wale mein C(=O)-OH hissa dabbe mein, teer 'Carboxylic portion (-COOH) responsible for its acidic character' ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Methanoic acid ke aldehydic aur carboxylic hisse (kitab ke PDF safha 111 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Methanoic acid mein carboxyl carbon par H laga hai, is liye aik hi molecule ko do tarah dekha ja sakta hai: H–C=O wala hissa aldehyde jaisa hai jo oxidise ho kar reducing agent ka kaam karta hai (Tollen's aur Fehling's test positive), aur C(=O)–OH wala hissa H⁺ de kar acid ka kaam karta hai.

Methanoic acid wahid monocarboxylic acid hai jo silver mirror test (Tollen's test) positive deta hai aur Fehling's solution ke saath eent jaisa surkh (brick red) precipitate deta hai. In reactions se methanoic acid pehchana jata hai.

blocks.title: Oxidation
blocks.text:
1. H₂ (ya H⁻) ka nikalna
2. O ya O₂ ka milna
3. X₂ ka milna
4. Electrons ka nikalna
5. Oxidation state ka barhna
Ethanedioic acid (oxalic acid) acidified KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ se oxidise ho kar carbon dioxide aur paani deta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Is equation mein Mn ki oxidation state 7+ se 2+ ho jati hai (reduction), aur carbon ki 3+ se 4+ (oxidation). Is tarah KMnO₄ oxidizing agent aur ethanedioic acid reducing agent hai.

blocks.prompt: Sodium hydrogencarbonate (NaHCO₃) se ethanoic acid aur phenol ko kaise alag pehchanein?
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid kafi strong acid hai aur NaHCO₃ se react kar ke CO₂ ke bulbule deta hai; phenol bohat kamzor acid hai aur bulbule nahi deta.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Acidic H: Na, NaOH, Na₂CO₃, NaHCO₃ ke saath salt (carbonates se CO₂ ke bulbule).
–OH ki jagah: SOCl₂/PCl₅ se acyl chlorides; alcohols se esters (conc. H₂SO₄).
LiAlH₄ acids ko primary alcohols mein reduce karta hai; H₂/Ni aur NaBH₄ nahi.
HCOOH aur (COOH)₂ oxidise ho kar CO₂ dete hain; HCOOH Tollen's aur Fehling's test deta hai.
